journey_path.description: Complete ordered navigation history: one entry per completed navigate/observe/decide/act cycle. Generic across any task/domain.

pageUrlBefore.description: Page URL observed before the action was taken.

selectedElement.description: Details of the observed element the selected action targeted, when applicable.

decisionReason.description: Rationale supplied by the reasoning provider for choosing the selected action.

pageUrlAfter.description: Page URL after the action, falling back to pageUrlBefore when the action did not navigate.

ref.description: Storage reference (path or URL) to the captured screenshot. The engine does not embed binary image data in this response.

reason.description: Why this screenshot was taken, e.g. "finish_state", "error", "scheduled".

errors.description: Raw technical diagnostics captured during the run: page JS errors, console errors, failed network requests, navigation/action failures, missing target elements, and safety/limit stops. Generic engine evidence, never converted into a business conclusion (see engineAssessment for that). Never contains cookies, auth headers, request bodies, credentials, tokens, personal data, or raw stack traces with environment paths.

stepIndex.description: Step during which this diagnostic was observed, when the engine has begun stepping. Absent for diagnostics observed before step 0 (e.g. during the initial navigation).

pageUrl.description: Page URL at the time this diagnostic was observed, when known.

actionType.description: Action type in effect when this diagnostic was observed, when applicable.

targetElementId.description: Engine-assigned element id (see observation.interactiveElements) the action targeted, when applicable. Never a raw selector or page content.

message.description: Concise, human-readable description of the diagnostic.

recoverable.description: Whether the run continued after this diagnostic was observed.

stoppedRun.description: Whether this diagnostic directly caused the run to stop.

displayedPrice.description: Price as displayed on the page, kept as text to preserve currency/formatting exactly as shown.

validityText.description: Visible validity/terms text as shown on the page, if any.

host_context_snapshot.description: Bounded, names-only footprint of cookies and localStorage/sessionStorage keys, captured only on the step this run's hostname changes (including the very first step, giving a landing-host baseline). Never a cookie or storage value -- see docs/architecture.md 'Blocker recovery'.

cookieNames.description: Cookie name/domain pairs from the whole browser context's cookie jar at this point -- never a value.

storageKeyNames.description: localStorage/sessionStorage key names present on the current page's own origin -- never a value.

engineAssessment.description: Engine-generated interpretation, kept separate from raw captures so downstream consumers never conflate observed evidence with classification.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary of what happened during the run.

notes.description: Any additional engine observations not captured elsewhere (e.g. anomalies noticed but not part of a capture module).

evidenceTierSummary.description: PR 1D (truthful milestone evaluation): a rollup of diagnostics.milestoneEvidence[].evidenceTier across every milestone this run satisfied, so a caller can see at a glance whether this run's outcome rests entirely on hard observed evidence or partly on inferred (semantic/model) judgement. assumedCount is always 0 -- see milestoneEvidenceRecord's own evidenceTier description. Present only when at least one criterion was satisfied during the run.

finishReason.description: Low-level reason the loop stopped, e.g. "stop_success_action", "max_steps", "domain_blocked", "unhandled_error".

engineVersion.description: Version of the navigation engine build that produced this response.

missingRequiredCriteriaIds.description: Ids of successCriteria entries with required !== false that were never satisfied by the time the run ended (e.g. a stop_success decision was rejected because required evidence was still missing, or the run stopped for another reason first). Present only when non-empty -- absent for a successful run, since the engine only honours stop_success once every required criterion is satisfied, and absent for any task with no required criteria at all.

memory.description: Bounded process.memoryUsage() samples taken at run start, after each step, and after browser/context cleanup -- generic Node runtime evidence only, never anything about the page/task being run. Exists to diagnose and correlate memory growth with incidents (e.g. an out-of-memory process kill) rather than to control engine behaviour. Present only when at least one sample was taken.

milestoneEvidence.description: One record per success criterion, appended the moment it first becomes satisfied (never re-recorded -- satisfiedCriteriaIds is a one-way ratchet, so a criterion contributes at most one record for the life of a run). Present only when at least one criterion was satisfied during the run.

journeyMemoryDiagnostics.description: Persistent Cross-Run Journey Memory (see docs/journey-memory.md and src/core/journeyMemory): present only when JOURNEY_MEMORY_ENABLED was set for this run -- entirely absent otherwise, the default. Reports the deterministic pre-run/recovery lookup that ran before any Claude call, whether/how its results influenced the run, and whether the one bounded extra recovery-focused Claude call fired.

storageAvailable.description: True when a Redis-backed journey-memory store was actually reachable for this run. False (never thrown as an error) when REDIS_URL was unset or Redis was unreachable -- the run always continues either way.

lookupCompleted.description: True when the pre-run lookup finished within its time budget; false when it timed out (see unavailableReason).

guidanceUsed.description: True once at least one historical record was actually injected into a reasoning prompt this run -- never true merely because lookup found candidates.

guidanceSucceeded.description: Present only when guidanceUsed is true: whether the run this guidance was injected into ended in success.

fallbackExplorationUsed.description: True when a remembered candidate was offered but no live candidate on the current page actually matched it, and the run fell back to ordinary bounded exploration instead of memory ever completing a milestone on its own.

lookupAttempted.description: Observability fix (production incident run_b3743f06-1667-443e-b9fa-e804aa5caecf): true whenever a pre-run lookup was actually initiated against the store (readEnabled and storage resolved), regardless of whether it completed -- lets a caller distinguish 'never attempted' from 'attempted and returned no_match/timeout'.

forwardSegmentsBuilt.description: Observability fix: count of forward (independently-verified progress) segments built from this run's steps before write-back, whether or not writeEnabled/storage allowed them to actually be persisted.

recoverySegmentsBuilt.description: Journey Memory recovery-segment-gap fix (production incident run_b3743f06-1667-443e-b9fa-e804aa5caecf): count of recovery segments built from ALL THREE diagnostic sources (recoveryAttemptDiagnostics, routeAttemptDiagnostics, alternativeCandidateDiagnostics -- see docs/journey-memory.md), after cross-source dedup, whether or not they were actually persisted.

recoveryCandidatesBuilt.description: Recovery-segment eligibility visibility fix (production incident run_fae0519a-ef71-46b9-a053-4ca82bb30000): candidate recovery inputs considered from the three diagnostic sources, before eligibility filtering/dedup.

recoveryCandidatesRejected.description: Same fix: how many of those candidates were rejected as ineligible or deduplicated -- see recoveryRejectionReasons for why, never a silent zero.

recoveryRejectionReasons.description: Same fix: short, generic rejection-reason categories with counts -- never raw page content.

segmentsWriteAttempted.description: Observability fix: count of segments a write was actually attempted for (writeEnabled and storage available and at least one eligible segment) -- distinguishes 'zero eligible segments' from 'write attempted but 0 succeeded' alongside segmentsWritten.

writeFailureReason.description: Observability fix: a short, non-sensitive category naming why a segments write did not fully succeed (e.g. 'redis_error', 'partial_failure') -- never a raw Redis error message, connection string, or credential.

diagnosticsAttached.description: Observability fix: always true when this journeyMemoryDiagnostics object itself is present on the response -- a simple, redundant-by-design marker a caller can check to confirm the field itself was not silently dropped by an intermediate hop (e.g. serialization/storage round-trip), independent of the server-side completion log this same run also emits.

persistenceConfirmed.description: Observability fix: present only when the engine could safely confirm (not merely attempt) that written records are retrievable -- e.g. a post-write read-back. Absent when not safely knowable within this run's own bounded budget.

recoveryDiagnostics.description: Milestone-anchored recovery: every recovery-anchor restore attempt this run made, whether it succeeded or not, plus the full candidate-route lifecycle trace. Present only when at least one restore or route attempt was recorded.

anchorsRecorded.description: How many recovery anchors (one per required milestone satisfied) this run recorded.

routeAttempts.description: Full route-lifecycle transition trace (candidate_selected -> route_active -> ... -> route_succeeded/candidate_exhausted) proving the engine genuinely followed and evaluated each candidate route, not only dispatched a click.

candidateRank.description: 1-based rank among the candidates tried at this anchor (1 = first tried, up to the bounded budget).

reObservationAttempted.description: Re-observation/reconstruction gap fix (production incident run_fae0519a-ef71-46b9-a053-4ca82bb30000): present on a terminal transition (anchor_restored, candidate_exhausted) reached via the branch-return-hop restoration path, true whenever bounded live re-observation was actually attempted before this transition was recorded.

fallbackNavigationAttempted.description: True once a last-resort checkpoint-reconstruction navigation (see core/branchReturnRecovery.ts) was actually dispatched for this restore episode.

fallbackNavigationUsed.description: True only when that reconstruction navigation both succeeded and its resulting page was live-verified as restored.

checkpointMatched.description: True when a decision-point checkpoint (core/decisionPointCheckpoint.ts) was found and used -- never itself proof of restoration.

targetFingerprint.description: Opaque decision-point fingerprint the restore sequence was aiming to reach.

restored.description: True once the target fingerprint was actually re-observed and matched.

alternativeExplorationDiagnostics.description: Alternative Route Exploration: every distinct candidate this run tried at a recovery anchor's decision point, and its progress outcome. Present only when at least one bounded exploration cycle ran.

attemptNumber.description: 1-based position of this attempt within this anchor's bounded exploration budget.

consentDiagnostics.description: Every consent surface the engine's own independent, deterministic classifier evaluated this run (detected or not), and any proactive accept-all action taken under consentInteractionPolicy "accept_optional". Present only when at least one surface was evaluated.

consentRetriesUsed.description: How many of this run's bounded consent-retry allowance were used -- never drawn from the navigation alternative-exploration budget.

evidence.description: Short, generic evidence strings explaining the classification (text/role/grouping signals), never full page content.

resolvedViaModelAssist.description: True when the accept-all control was identified via the bounded, independently-verified model-assist fallback rather than the deterministic, configured-language wording table -- i.e. the page's own wording matched none of the configured languages.

languageAmbiguous.description: True when this surface showed genuine consent-context evidence but the deterministic, configured-language wording table could not resolve a confident choice shape from it.

pageLanguage.description: The page's own declared language (<html lang>, normalised to its primary subtag) at this step, when present.

milestoneEvidenceRecord.description: Explains why the engine judged one specific success criterion satisfied: which page it was evaluated against, in which phase of the step, and what evidence (a matched URL pattern, a matched selector, a deterministic vocabulary-overlap score, or a semanticVerifier's own cited evidence) actually satisfied it. This is engine classification (the "why"), kept in diagnostics rather than captures, which stays raw, website-derived evidence only.

criterionType.description: The criterion's own successCriteria[].type value, e.g. "semantic_page_match".

description.description: The criterion's own description text, echoed for readability.

phase.description: Whether this criterion was evaluated before this step's own action was dispatched, or immediately after it.

pageUrl.description: Page URL at the moment this criterion was judged satisfied.

evidenceSource.description: Which mechanism actually satisfied the criterion, e.g. "url_pattern", "element_present", "semantic_page_match:deterministic", "semantic_page_match:verifier", "data_layer_event", "network_event".

evidenceTier.description: PR 1D (truthful milestone evaluation): a deterministic classification of how evidenceSource established this criterion. "observed": a direct mechanical DOM/URL/event read with no reasoning-layer or model involvement (url_pattern, element_present, data_layer_event, network_event). "inferred": a vocabulary-overlap score or model judgement over textual similarity (semantic_page_match, deterministic or via an optional semanticVerifier) -- real evidence, never a literal fact. "assumed": reserved for a milestone satisfied with no independent corroborating evidence at all; never produced by this engine's own evaluator today (enforced by an invariant test), included in the enum so its absence from a real run is auditable from the response itself rather than merely asserted in documentation.

score.description: Deterministic vocabulary-overlap score or semanticVerifier confidence for an "inferred" entry; always 1.0 (unambiguous) for an "observed" entry. Always present, uniformly across every evidenceTier.

matchedValue.description: The literal pattern/selector/match object that satisfied this criterion, when applicable.

reason.description: Short human-readable explanation of why the criterion was judged satisfied.

containerMemoryDiagnostics.description: The opt-in container-memory circuit breaker's (MEMORY_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED) latest sample and outcome, from generic Linux cgroup memory accounting (cgroup v2, falling back to v1) -- see docs/architecture.md 'Container memory circuit breaker'. Present only when that breaker was enabled for this run. A single latest snapshot, not a growing history. available: false means this container did not expose readable cgroup memory files, so the breaker was inert for the whole run (never breaches) rather than failing the task.

version.description: Which cgroup version's memory files were read.

limitBytes.description: The container memory limit used (cgroup-reported, or MEMORY_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_LIMIT_BYTES if set).

latestSampleBytes.description: The most recent cgroup current-usage reading, in bytes.

breached.description: Whether the latest sample was at or above thresholdFraction of limitBytes, causing the run to stop early via the container_memory_threshold_reached status.

resourceRoutingDiagnostics.description: Counts and approximate bytes of network requests allowed/blocked by low-memory browser mode (LOW_MEMORY_BROWSER_MODE) -- see docs/architecture.md 'Low-memory browser mode'. Present only when that mode was enabled for this run. Routing applies at the browser-context level, so it covers the run's original page and every popup/new-tab Playwright creates in that same context (adopted, nested, rejected, or otherwise) from the instant each one is created -- byResourceType is the run-level total across all of them; byPage breaks the same evidence down per page.

byResourceType.description: One entry per Playwright request.resourceType() value actually seen during the run, summed across every page -- inherently bounded by Playwright's own small, fixed resource-type vocabulary, never per-request.

byPage.description: One entry per browser Page routing ever covered this run: the original page, plus every popup/new-tab (adopted, nested, rejected, or otherwise) -- never discarded even for a popup that was rejected or closed.

resourceRoutingPageDiagnostics.description: One browser Page's own resource-routing coverage under low-memory browser mode. role is "original" for the one page the run started on, "adopted_popup"/"nested_popup" once the engine's own surface-adoption decision labelled it (nested meaning its opener was itself an already-adopted surface, not the original page), and "popup" for any other popup/new-tab (observed-only, rejected, or not yet classified). contextId/surfaceId mirror the same values the analytics capture modules use for this page once known -- absent until an adoption decision has labelled it.

duplicateRegistrationPrevented.description: True if a later attempt to register routing for this same page was made and safely no-op'd -- proof no duplicate route handler was ever added.

closedAt.description: Absent while the page is still open.

navigationCount.description: Main-frame navigations observed on this page while routing was active.

routingErrors.description: Bounded list of route.fulfill/continue failures for this page -- normally empty.

routingReleasedOnClose.description: True once this page closed and its routing state/listeners were released.

resourceRoutingEntry.description: One resource type's tally under low-memory browser mode. allowedBytesMeasured is summed from real Content-Length response headers (a measurement; requests without that header contribute 0, so this can under-count but never fabricates a number). blockedBytesEstimated is blockedCount times a fixed, documented per-resource-type average -- an estimate, never a measurement, since a blocked resource is never actually fetched.

resourceType.description: One of Playwright's own request.resourceType() values, e.g. "image", "script", "xhr" -- never anything about a specific site or brand.

memorySample.description: One process.memoryUsage() sample. See diagnostics.memory above.

reasoningProviderDecisionSummary.description: Safe per-decision usage summary for one reasoning-provider attempt. Never includes prompts, raw model responses, page content, request bodies, API keys, headers, or credentials.

stepIndex.description: Step index this decision was made for, when available (absent for a decision made before any step is known, e.g. an immediate fallback when no actions are allowed).

attempt.description: Attempt number within this decision: 0 is the first try, 1 is the single allowed retry, -1 marks a fallback produced without a model call.

confidence.description: Model-reported confidence for this decision, when available.

elementSelection.description: Bounded diagnostic of which interactive elements from this step's Observation actually reached the model's prompt for this attempt, and why.

consentControlIntent.description: This decision's self-reported consent semantics (see safety.consentInteractionPolicy's own description). Present whenever the provider produced a parseable response -- on acceptance and on a consent_policy_violation rejection alike -- so the full attempt-by-attempt consent history is auditable even when nothing was ultimately dispatched.

consentPolicyCompliant.description: Whether consentControlIntent (above) complied with this run's safety.consentInteractionPolicy, per the engine's deterministic enforcement. Present alongside consentControlIntent.

promptElementSelectionDiagnostic.description: Bounded diagnostic explaining which interactive elements from a step's Observation were actually included in one decision attempt's model prompt, and why (see src/reasoning/promptBuilder.ts). Never duplicates the full observation or the raw prompt -- `selected` is capped at the same per-step interactive-element limit already applied to the prompt itself, and `excludedRelevantCount` is a count only, never a list.

candidateCount.description: Total interactive elements observed on the page this step, before any truncation.

selectedCount.description: Number of elements actually included in the prompt sent to the model.

relevantSelectedCount.description: Of selectedCount, how many were selected because their accessible name shares literal vocabulary with the objective/successCriteria text.

structuralSelectedCount.description: Of selectedCount, how many were selected by the generic, language-independent structural/positional fallback (never text-based) rather than lexical relevance.

excludedRelevantCount.description: Count of elements that scored positively on lexical relevance but still did not fit within the prompt's element cap. A count only, never a list, to keep this diagnostic bounded.

guaranteedInclusionCount.description: Of selectedCount, how many were included only because they strongly matched the currently-unresolved milestone specifically, via the bounded guaranteed-inclusion top-up (see src/reasoning/promptBuilder.ts).

truncationStrategy.description: Short, fixed label naming which selection strategy produced this diagnostic -- "none" when candidateCount was already within the cap.

omissionReason.description: Present only when excludedRelevantCount > 0, explaining generically why a relevant candidate still did not survive.

selected.description: The elements actually included in the prompt, and why -- bounded to selectedCount entries.

reasoningProviderDiagnostics.description: Aggregated, per-run reasoning-provider usage diagnostics, derived from the provider's own decision log (never a second usage-tracking mechanism). Contains only safe aggregate/per-decision metadata -- never prompts, raw model responses, page content, request bodies, API keys, headers, or credentials. Reports token usage as source data for cost calculation downstream, not a computed monetary cost, since model pricing can change independently of this engine. Versioned independently of the top-level schemaVersion so this structure can evolve on its own.

version.description: Version of this reasoning-provider diagnostics structure, e.g. "1.2.0". Bumped from "1.1.0" to "1.2.0" for the consent-policy-enforcement audit trail (see safety.consentInteractionPolicy's own description): the additive, optional consentInteractionPolicy (the resolved policy for this run) and decisions[].consentControlIntent/consentPolicyCompliant -- no existing field removed or renamed. Bumped from "1.0.0" to "1.1.0" earlier for the additive, optional decisions[].elementSelection diagnostic -- no existing field removed or renamed.

provider.description: Reasoning provider that produced this run's decisions, e.g. "claude" or "mock".

model.description: Model identifier used by the provider, when applicable. Absent for the mock provider.

callCount.description: Number of real provider calls made this run, each counted once. Excludes immediate safe fallbacks produced without a call. Always 0 for the mock provider.

rejectedDecisionCount.description: Decisions rejected by engine-side validation or by a provider/API error.

fallbackDecisionCount.description: Decisions where the provider could not produce a valid decision and returned a safe stop_blocked fallback instead.

retryCount.description: Number of retry attempts (beyond each decision's first attempt) made this run.

consentInteractionPolicy.description: The resolved safety.consentInteractionPolicy (task-request.schema.json) this run actually enforced -- present so a caller can audit which policy applied even when the request itself omitted the field and the documented default ("reject_optional") applied instead. Absent only for a provider (e.g. the mock provider) that never resolved a policy.

decisions.description: Optional per-decision usage summary, one entry per attempt recorded in the provider's decision log.

semanticVerifierDecisionSummary.description: Safe per-decision usage summary for one SemanticCriterionVerifier attempt. Never includes prompts, raw model responses, page content, request bodies, API keys, headers, or credentials.

attempt.description: Attempt number within this verification call: 0 is the first try, 1 is the single allowed retry, -1 marks a reused cached verdict (cache_hit).

confidence.description: Model-reported confidence for this verification, when available.

evidence.description: Short evidence excerpt the model cited from the page signals already visible in Observation (title/headings/interactive element text), supporting or explaining its verdict.

semanticVerifierDiagnostics.description: Aggregated, per-run usage diagnostics for the optional SemanticCriterionVerifier -- a bounded, structured-output model call used only to adjudicate a semantic_page_match criterion the deterministic (lexical token-overlap) evaluator could not resolve (e.g. because the objective and the page are written in different languages), entirely separate from navigation decisions. See src/reasoning/semanticCriterionVerifier.ts and docs/n8n-integration.md 'Generic multilingual semantic_page_match verification'. Absent entirely when no verifier was configured for the run (the deterministic-only default). callCount excludes cacheHitCount: a cached verdict is reused for identical (criterion, page-evidence) pairs so an unchanged page is never re-verified across repeated stop_success attempts. Versioned independently of the top-level schemaVersion so this structure can evolve on its own.

provider.description: Provider that produced this run's semantic verifications, e.g. "claude".

callCount.description: Number of real model calls made this run (excludes cache hits).

cacheHitCount.description: Number of times a cached verdict was reused for unchanged (criterion, page-evidence) evidence instead of making a new model call.

rejectedCount.description: Verifications that did not satisfy the criterion, including malformed output, low confidence, missing evidence, or a provider/API error -- the verifier fails closed.

dataLayerDelta.description: Generic, mechanical before/after delta of window.dataLayer's contents around one click -- a cursor/position delta, never a full re-snapshot of either side. See src/capture-modules/dataLayerDelta.ts.

available.description: False when no dataLayer array existed on the page either before or after the click. True whenever a dataLayer array exists (even if newEntries is empty, meaning present but unchanged).

newEntries.description: Entries pushed to dataLayer since immediately before this click. When replaced is true, this is the entire post-click array (the prior contents no longer form a valid prefix, e.g. a full page navigation or an explicit reset).

replaced.description: True when the dataLayer array was reset or replaced rather than appended to.

actionAnalytics.description: Generic, action-attributed analytics evidence for one click the engine dispatched -- the single mechanism used for every journey, never a per-journey capture. GA4 field naming is deliberately non-causal: a request observed inside the bounded post-click window is temporally correlated with the click, never asserted to have been caused by it.

actionId.description: Stable id for this one physical engine action, format "${taskId}:action:${stepIndex}". Also present on the parent cta_clicks record. Joinable across cta_clicks/actionAnalytics without relying on fuzzy timestamp/label matching.

captureWindowStartedAt.description: Read immediately before this action's own GA4/dataLayer-push correlation window opened -- before dispatch, distinct from the (much later) top-level cta_clicks.timestamp, which is when that record was serialised.

captureWindowEndedAt.description: Read once this action's own correlation window closed, after an adaptive settle extension.

physicalClickDispatchedAt.description: Read immediately before Playwright dispatched the real click. Absent when the target never reached dispatch (e.g. a stale/unactionable target).

ga4RequestsObservedDuringActionWindow.description: GA4-style requests observed within a short, adaptively-extended window after this click. Correlation, not causation.

dataLayerPushesObservedDuringActionWindo.description: Real-time dataLayer.push captures observed in this same window (the persistent push-observer stream, not the before/after dataLayerDelta above) -- recovers a click-handler push that a full-page navigation would otherwise erase from dataLayerDelta (see dataLayerDelta.replaced).

advancedJourney.description: True iff the URL or title changed, or a success criterion newly became satisfied, as a direct result of this click.

newlySatisfiedCriteriaIds.description: Ids of success criteria that were unsatisfied before this click and satisfied immediately after it.

verifierDecisions.description: Any semanticVerifier decisions made while evaluating success criteria immediately after this click.

captureHealth.description: Structural health of this action's own capture mechanism -- never an interpretation of the target site. See src/capture-modules/analyticsCaptureClassification.ts.

dataLayerPushListenerActive.description: Whether the run-lifetime dataLayer.push observer actually attached to this page/context.

networkListenerActive.description: Whether the run-lifetime GA4 request listener is attached for this action's page/context.

unobservedDataLayerGapPossible.description: True only when dataLayerDelta.replaced is true and no push-observer entry inside this action's own window can account for what a click handler may have pushed immediately before that navigation tore its JS context down.

analyticsCaptureSummary.description: This engine's classification of what the analytics evidence for one action does/doesn't prove -- see src/capture-modules/analyticsCaptureClassification.ts. Never a claim about the target site beyond what the evidence itself shows.

classifiedEvidence.description: Every GA4 request/dataLayer push observed in this action's window, tagged with the specific category it earned -- window/segment ownership alone is never sufficient to confirm a tag. See src/capture-modules/analyticsCaptureClassification.ts's classifyEvidenceItem.

confirmedGa4Events.description: GA4 requests in this action's window classified CLICK_EVENT/PHYSICAL_PAGE_CHANGE/VIRTUAL_PAGE_CHANGE/FORM_OR_CONFIGURATOR_STATE -- never gated on an exact page-location match, and never confirmed merely by window ownership.

unresolvedGa4Candidates.description: GA4 requests in this action's window classified OTHER_MEANINGFUL_EVENT or CORRELATION_UNRESOLVED -- not confirmed as this action's own evidence.

observed.description: Whether any consent-mode signal (gtag consent call or GA4 gcs param) was found at all.

required.description: Whether this run's consentInteractionPolicy requires optional consent to have been accepted.

ctaElementDestinationUrl.description: The clicked CTA element's own href/destination, unchanged -- supporting/diagnostic context, never analytics evidence itself.

analyticsEventDestinationUrl.description: GA4 Enhanced Measurement link_url (or an equivalent dataLayer push field) -- the destination URL the analytics event itself emitted.

analyticsPageLocation.description: GA4's own dl / a dataLayer push's own page_location field, verbatim -- never overwritten by browserResultingUrl.

analyticsFullUrl.description: A dataLayer push's own full_url-shaped field, verbatim -- never overwritten by browserResultingUrl.

analyticsVirtualPageUrl.description: A dataLayer push's own virtualpage_url-shaped field, verbatim -- confirms a virtual/SPA destination even when the browser URL never changes.

browserResultingUrl.description: The tracked page's actual resulting URL after this action -- supporting navigation/diagnostic evidence only, never a confirmation gate.

urlRelationship.description: Diagnostic-only relationship between the analytics-emitted location and the browser/CTA URLs -- never used to gate confirmation.

triggerSegment.description: Which phase of this action produced the primary confirming evidence. Absent when no evidence confirmed this action at all.

primaryClickEventStatus.description: The dedicated-click-tag outcome for this action, distinct from `status` above -- an action can be CAPTURED overall from associated page/virtual-state evidence while this is WEBSITE_NO_OBSERVED_CLICK_TAG. See src/capture-modules/analyticsCaptureClassification.ts's PrimaryClickEventStatus.

primaryClickEvent.description: The single richest CLICK_EVENT-classified record for this action -- present only when primaryClickEventStatus is CAPTURED.

supportingEvidence.description: Every other CLICK_EVENT-classified record describing the same physical click as primaryClickEvent (e.g. a generic GTM auto-event trigger alongside the richer business event) -- never a second primary.

associatedEvents.description: Confirmed non-click evidence for this action (PHYSICAL_PAGE_CHANGE/VIRTUAL_PAGE_CHANGE/FORM_OR_CONFIGURATOR_STATE) -- present independently of whether a dedicated click tag was ever observed.

unresolvedCandidates.description: CORRELATION_UNRESOLVED-classified records for this action -- genuinely ambiguous candidates, never silently folded into either primaryClickEvent or associatedEvents.

classifiedEvidenceItem.description: One GA4 request or dataLayer push inside an action's window, tagged with the category it actually earned -- see src/capture-modules/analyticsCaptureClassification.ts's classifyEvidenceItem. Exactly one of ga4Event/dataLayerPush is set.

triggerSegment.description: Which phase of the action produced this specific item -- see the enum on analyticsCaptureSummary.triggerSegment. Always populated for an item observed in-window; never inferred downstream.

trustedDomainEntry.description: One hostname the run trusted for navigation, and why.

sourceUrl.description: The URL this trust decision was derived from, when applicable (absent for caller_supplied).

externalDomainCandidate.description: A hostname discovered during preflight on a different registrable domain than the site being navigated. Never auto-trusted -- surfaced here so a caller/operator can review and explicitly add it to the task's allowedDomains if the run is meant to cross into it.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this candidate was not auto-trusted.

rejectedDomainCandidate.description: A URL considered during preflight and rejected outright by the conservative candidate-validation policy (unsupported protocol, localhost, loopback, or link-local address).

domainDiscoveryDiagnostics.description: Diagnostics from the engine's deterministic preflight domain-discovery phase, which runs before the Claude-driven navigation loop and proposes an allowedDomains set so a caller need not enumerate every domain/subdomain a journey might use. See docs/architecture.md 'Preflight domain discovery' for the full conservative validation policy this reflects.

startRegistrableDomain.description: Registrable (eTLD+1) domain of the start hostname, resolved via a maintained Public Suffix List-backed library. Null for hosts with no PSL-registrable domain (bare IPs, "localhost", or a hostname that is itself only a public suffix).

finalUrl.description: URL the initial navigation actually landed on, after following any HTTP redirects from startUrl.

redirectChain.description: Ordered list of URLs visited following a redirect from startUrl through to finalUrl (inclusive of both ends).

canonicalUrl.description: The landed page's <link rel="canonical"> URL, when present.

trustedDomains.description: Every hostname trusted for this run, and why -- the union of caller-supplied allowedDomains and everything preflight discovery proposed.

externalCandidates.description: Hostnames discovered on a different registrable domain than the site being navigated, never auto-trusted.

rejectedCandidates.description: URLs rejected outright during preflight discovery by the conservative candidate-validation policy.

proposedAllowedDomains.description: Hostnames preflight discovery itself proposed (excludes hostnames the caller already supplied explicitly).

allowedDomainsUsed.description: The final allowedDomains set actually enforced for this run: caller-supplied allowedDomains (if any) unioned with proposedAllowedDomains.

blockedReason.description: Present only when preflight discovery itself blocked the run (e.g. the initial navigation redirected to an unsafe host).

raw.description: Unmodified dataLayer entries as read from the page at capture time.

source.description: Which browsing context/frame this entry was actually read from -- a generic, mechanical capture-provenance fact, never an interpretation of what the entry means.

frameOrigin.description: Origin (scheme+host+port) of the child frame this entry was read from -- present only for source: "child_frame".

contextId.description: Stable id distinguishing the tracked page ("main") from a specific adopted popup context.

truncated.description: True when this entry's raw array was cut down to the configured per-snapshot cap (oldest dropped first) -- never a silent truncation.

params.description: Raw query/body parameters observed on the outgoing GA4 network request.

method.description: HTTP method of the outgoing request, e.g. "GET", "POST".

postDataRaw.description: Raw POST/sendBeacon request body, bounded and truncated (never dropped) past a fixed size cap. Absent for a GET request, or a POST/sendBeacon request with no body.

postDataParams.description: Body parameters, generically parsed only when the raw body is unambiguously form-urlencoded -- never a client-specific parsing rule. One entry per newline-delimited hit (a batched GA4 sendBeacon body concatenates multiple hits this way). Absent when the body doesn't confidently parse this way.

measurementId.description: Mechanically read from the standard GA4 Measurement Protocol "tid" parameter (query or body) when present. Never inferred when absent.

consentState.description: Mechanically read from the standard GA4 consent-state parameters ("gcs", "dma", "dma_cps") when present, verbatim. Never inferred when absent.

source.description: Which browsing context/frame this request was actually observed on -- a generic, mechanical capture-provenance fact, never an interpretation of what the request means.

contextId.description: Stable id distinguishing the tracked page ("main") from a specific adopted popup context.

frameOrigin.description: Origin of the child frame this request originated from -- present only for source: "child_frame".

truncated.description: True when postDataRaw was cut down to the configured size cap -- never a silent truncation.

event.description: "adopted": a popup/new-tab was adopted onto the surface stack (mirrors actionResult.surfaceAdopted=true). "rejected": a popup was offered but not adopted, domain/budget (mirrors actionResult.adoptionRejectedReason). "returned": returnToParentSurface successfully popped back to the parent Page. "return_failed": a return-to-parent attempt could not verify the parent surface. "closed_unexpectedly": the adopted surface's own Page was found closed before any go_back-driven return was attempted.

pageUrl.description: Set on "adopted"/"returned"/"return_failed" when the relevant page's URL was available.

reason.description: Set on "rejected"/"return_failed" -- see actionResult.adoptionRejectedReason and returnToParentSurface's own ReturnToParentResult.reason.

relevanceScore.description: Mirrors actionResult.relevanceScore -- see its own doc comment. Set on "adopted"/"rejected" whenever the relevance gate ran for this attempt.

relevanceTier.description: Mirrors actionResult.relevanceTier -- see its own doc comment.

consentActionTaken.description: Mirrors actionResult.consentActionTaken -- see its own doc comment.

extendedAllowedDomain.description: Mirrors actionResult.extendedAllowedDomain -- see its own doc comment. Set only on "adopted".

candidateSurfaceFingerprint.description: Mirrors actionResult.candidateSurfaceFingerprint -- see its own doc comment. Set on "adopted"/"rejected" whenever the relevance gate ran for this attempt.

fingerprintPreviouslySeen.description: Mirrors actionResult.fingerprintPreviouslySeen -- see its own doc comment.

popupReconsiderationReason.description: Mirrors actionResult.popupReconsiderationReason -- see its own doc comment.

surfaceAdoptionDiagnostics.description: Every adopted-surface lifecycle event this run (adoption, rejection, return-to-parent, or unexpected closure) -- see CLAUDE.md and docs/architecture.md "Surface adoption" and "Return-to-parent recovery". Present only when at least one such event occurred.

returnAttempts.description: How many return-to-parent hops (go_back-while-off-main) this run made, successful or not.

analyticsReportingRow.description: One flattened, deduplicated, deterministically-ordered engine-owned analytics reporting record -- see src/capture-modules/analyticsReportingRows.ts and docs/n8n-analytics-reporting-migration.md.

runId.description: Run identity -- this engine has no separate run concept beyond taskId, so runId and taskId are always equal.

schemaVersion.description: The response's own schemaVersion at the moment this row was generated.

journeyType.description: Echoes TaskRequest.journeyType when the task supplied one.

journeySequence.description: 1-based, continuous across the whole run -- assigned only after final ordering and deduplication.

eventId.description: Stable, deterministic (sha256-derived) identity for one distinct captured analytics event -- never the raw payload text itself (see rawEvidenceJson). Absent for a START_PAGE row and for a CTA_CLICK row with no confirmed primary click.

journeyRelevant.description: True on every CTA_CLICK row -- every dispatched CTA click action was itself selected by the reasoning layer in pursuit of this run's objective.

eventClassification.description: EvidenceClassification (see $defs/classifiedEvidenceItem.classification) widened with two reporting-only values: JOURNEY_MARKER (the START_PAGE row) and UNCLASSIFIED_RAW_CAPTURE (a defensive fallback, structurally unreachable today).

vehicleYear.description: A generic alias-extracted page/vehicle attribute (see the coordinator's own GENERIC ALIAS-BASED FIELD EXTRACTION list) -- never a brand-specific field, and empty when a page never emits it.

collectionEndpoint.description: GA4 request's own origin+pathname (e.g. "https://www.google-analytics.com/g/collect") -- absent for dataLayer-sourced rows.

rawEvidenceJson.description: Canonicalised (recursively key-sorted) JSON of this row's underlying raw GA4 request or dataLayer push entry -- distinct from eventId, which is a hash and never the payload text itself.
